meta.description: Group Congo Construct (GCC Sarl), based in Lubumbashi, designs, builds and renovates for individuals and businesses across the DRC.

hero.title: Plan right. Build to last.
hero.text: GCC Sarl designs, builds and renovates for individuals and businesses throughout the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

about.title: A Congolese company, since 2018
about.text: Group Congo Construct is based in Lubumbashi and works across the DRC. We start every project with the study: a well-studied project is built better, costs less and lasts longer.

services.intro: From study to handover, a single point of contact.

parcours.label: Construction stages
descriptions: The slab is poured and the steel reinforcement is ready for the walls to go up.
The walls rise and gradually shape the spaces of the house.
The roof frame takes shape and prepares for the roof to be laid.
The roof is laid and covers the frame.
The plaster goes on and the doors and windows are fitted.
The house is finished, with its paved driveway, lawn and flower beds.
